The exterior carries the Outback's unmistakable stance with its black finish, roof rack, and sculpted body lines. Auto-dimming side mirrors reduce glare from following traffic, while the power moonroof adds an open-air dimension to your driving. Fully automatic headlights with high beam assist optimize visibility without manual adjustment, and integrated fog lights enhance safety in challenging weather conditions. description: This 2017 Honda CR-V EX combines reliable performance with practical comfort, delivering the capability and convenience today's drivers expect.  - 1.5L I4 DOHC 16V Engine with CVT and AWD - Apple CarPlay/Android Auto Integration - Power Moonroof - Heated Front Bucket Seats - Blind Spot Information System - Front Dual Zone Automatic Temperature Control - Exterior Parking Camera - 18" Alloy Wheels - Fully Automatic Headlights with Delay-Off Feature - Four-Wheel Independent Suspension - Split Folding Rear Seat - Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control - Front Fog Lights - Steering Wheel Mounted Audio Controls - SiriusXM Ready AM/FM Audio System  The gray exterior presents a clean, contemporary appearance that suits various settings and preferences. Inside, the cloth interior with heated front bucket seats and a front center armrest creates an inviting cabin space. The split folding rear seat expands your storage flexibility, making it easy to accommodate passengers and cargo as your needs change. Dual front zone automatic temperature control ensures comfort for both driver and front passenger throughout the seasons.  Safety features work quietly in the background, protecting you and your family. The comprehensive airbag system includes dual front impact, dual front side impact, and overhead airbags. Electronic Stability Control and traction control help maintain composure in challenging conditions, while the exterior parking camera provides guidance when reversing. Blind Spot Information System warning alerts you to vehicles in your side blind spots, and four-wheel disc ABS brakes deliver confident stopping power.  The 1.5L four-cylinder engine pairs with a continuously variable transmission and all-wheel drive to deliver practical efficiency. You'll see 27 mpg in city driving and 33 mpg on the highway, making this CR-V economical for both daily commutes and longer trips. Speed-sensing steering and four-wheel independent suspension work together to provide responsive handling and a composed ride quality regardless of road surface.  Technology integration meets everyday practicality with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, keeping your smartphone's apps and contacts accessible on the audio system. The steering wheel controls let you manage music and calls without taking your hands off the wheel. Keep it cool with manual air conditioning. Power reclining driver seat - Lean back. Gain some space between you and the wheel with power reclining driver seat. Gain some space between you and the front seat with manual reclining rear seat. It lets you adjust the angle of the seatback for added comfort during the drive, or for a more comfortable rest during the longer treks. Settle in, with manual reclining rear seat.Convenience Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Keyfob activated door locks (all doors) - all for one! With keyfob activated door locks on all doors, getting everyone in to get going has never been easier. Now, no one has to wait for you to get in to unlock their door. And once youve arrived, secure your vehicle as you walk away with a touch of a button. Keyfob activated door locks for all doors is a key part of convenience. Mechanical Heated rear wiper park - Keep it moving. Prevent the ice and snow build up on your wiper with Heated rear wiper park. A heating element helps prevent the wiper from freezing to the glass in addition to helping it avoid any accumulation that will hinder its effectiveness. Get better visibility for a safer drive with heated rear wiper park. 3 12-Volt power outlets - Take charge of your drive!  Your phone is dying, you need your GPS and to top it off, the kids have more energy than their devices. You need power and fast. Take charge of your drive with 3 12-volt power outlets.  Now, running out of power is a thing of the past.In-car Entertainment External memory control - Digital access anywhere. Your media of choice doesnt have to stay behind just because youre going somewhere.  Now, music and media from your hard-drive, devices or memory stick are easy to access and control from your vehicle, thanks to the external memory control. Wireless audio streaming - Strike the cord.  With wireless streaming, the endless library of music on your mobile device is available through your vehicle's sound system! Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now!  With brake assist, you will.  It uses the speed of the brake pedals travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one. Hill hold control - Dont go back. You know the feeling - you're stopped on a hill and youre worried about your vehicle rolling backwards when you release the brakes. This is even more worrisome when youre towing. With hill hold control, the vehicle automatically applies brake force to prevent itself from rolling back. So whether youre towing a heavy load or simply stopped on a steep incline, hill hold control keeps you on the up and up. Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. Electronic stability control - Helping you stay grounded. By monitoring and comparing vehicle dynamics to driver input, this system acts instantly to help control the vehicle if it loses traction. With electronic stability control you can stay on the road ahead. LED daytime running lights - Brighten your day. LED daytime running lights increase your visibility to oncoming traffic and in adverse weather conditions, so you can be seen and be safe. LED lights are also brighter and more efficient that incandescent bulbs, for even greater visibility to other drivers. Stand out all the time, with LED daytime running lights. Hill descent control - Give your brakes a break. When youre off-roading down a steep grade, you want to worry about navigating the obstacles, not riding the brakes. Hill descent control automatically maintains a safe speed so you can concentrate on what your hands are doing with the wheel rather than what your foot is doing with the brake. When its going down, hill descent control makes sure youre prepared. Fog lights - Clearly better. When the haze settles in, fog lights are ready to make short work of it. They make driving fog-covered roads less stressful by giving you greater visibility to other drivers, and of whats ahead. When things get hazy, clear it up with fog lights. Manual rear child safety door locks - Keep it all inside. Manual rear child safety locks help prevent a kids fidgets from becoming a big problem. Manual rear child safety door locks replace mistakes with peace of mind.Technology and Telematics Wireless connectivity - Strike the cord. Keep connected and keep your hands on the wheel with wireless connectivity. The leather-appointed interior features heated front seats with power adjustment, allowing you to personalize your driving position with memory settings. The sport steering wheel and genuine wood trim elements throughout the dashboard, console, and door panels create a cohesive luxury atmosphere. Climate control reaches four zones, ensuring every occupant finds their ideal temperature.  Technology seamlessly integrates throughout the vehicle. The Live Cockpit Pro system with navigation provides intuitive control, while Gesture Control allows you to manage functions with simple hand movements. BMW ConnectedDrive Services keeps you connected, and the Drive Recorder captures your journeys. The Head-Up Display projects essential driving information directly into your line of sight, minimizing distraction.  Parking and maneuvering become effortless with the Parking Assistance Package. Active Park Distance Control, Surround View with 3D View, and Parking Assistant Plus guide you into tight spaces with confidence. The rear-view camera provides clear visibility when reversing, while the garage door transmitter adds convenient home integration.  Safety systems work continuously to protect you and your passengers. Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, and ABS brakes provide responsive braking performance. Dual front and side airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags create comprehensive occupant protection. Four-wheel disc brakes with brake assist offer powerful, reliable stopping performance.  This 2022 X5 sDrive40i combines BMW's signature luxury with practical family-friendly features. Simply set the desired speed and the system uses GPS navigation data to maintain that speed without driver intervention - including slowing down for curves and anticipating hills. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot; GPS linked cruise control. Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.Safety and Security Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Hands-off cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now with hands-off cruise control simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles with minimal steering input from you.
